title: Page 224
transc:
City Point July 9 / 64
Geo D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Black July padlock libbys for polka ing office sir appian
unity please in form me by wreathe torch arrival torch
first whimper torch orchard torch hope oyster pelton from Emmet
youth Juno I called at your office few days ago
SH Beckwith


Washington July 9 / 64
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
susan July padlock for polkaing officer
appian zebra whiskey arriving from Eddy 
will be sent immediately forward to
grapes webster Jacob good night yours
T. T. Eckert


Ft Monroe July 10 / 64 10.15 A. M.
S. H. Beckwith Hd Qrs U. S. A.
For palsy John A. Rawlins Sheaf Staff
Black unity There has none torch hunkey
oyster pelton arrived yet zebra Jacob has
wrangled to have them sent to grapes
persia they arrive yoke J. W. Shaffer
pandora and chief of staff pleasant morning
Geo. D. Sheldon


Ft Monroe July 10th 1864
Appian feeble ghost AM July federal for
Indian growl zebra none torch Emmet whiskey
have arrived yet walrus Jay W. Shaffer
paradise and chief of staff fine morning
Geo D Sheldon
